title: Understanding Recurring Deposits (RD)
content: A Recurring Deposit (RD) is a term deposit scheme offered by banks that allows individuals with regular incomes to deposit a fixed amount every month into their RD account and earn interest at rates comparable to Fixed Deposits. RDs allow investors to build a disciplined savings habit without needing a large upfront lump sum, with tenure options ranging from 6 months to 10 years.
